paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 7.4 as of July 24, 2026, representing a 12.46 percent increase from the prior close. Over a window of 20 sessions, the stock has decreased by 15.91 percent.

There is one new news item in the last 24 hours, with a headline from Stocktwits stating that Fermi Cofounder Toby Neugebauer says the market clearly wants cooperation between him and the company's board as FRMI stock surges to over 3-month highs.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent SEC filings, including four 8-K forms, one 8-K/A form, and one SCHEDULE 13G form, with the most recent filing being an 8-K form on July 23, 2026, which discloses the appointment of four new officers. There is also one Form 4 filing in the feed.
